Subject: Re: Annual commitment — staggered invoicing / VAT agent

Hi Priyom,

We reviewed the commitment terms and need to align on two operational points before we route the PO: 1) Brightbox prefers a monthly taper (instead of quarterly tranches) for the first 6 months, with an automatic 7-day withdrawal window for each month; and 2) for EU VAT purposes our tax team requires evidence of an appointed VAT agent to accept invoices on our behalf (we can provide agent details but need Redwood to include the agent name on the invoice and a signed authority letter).

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can produce monthly invoices with sequential invoice numbers (we need a predictable numbering scheme to match our AP import)
- Whether you can include the VAT agent name on the invoice header and whether you accept a scanned authority form (see attached sample from our side)

If yes, we can kick the PO and the first withdrawal window as early as Oct 1.

Thanks,
Samir
Finance Manager, Brightbox AI

Samir — thanks for the clear ask. Yes, we can support a monthly taper and include a VAT agent name on the invoice header. Details below and I attached a sample invoice and our proposed mutual action plan so we’re aligned operationally.

What Redwood will do:
- Deliver monthly invoices for the first 6 months (taper scheme) with sequential invoice numbers starting RBX-202610-M01 and incrementing M02, M03, etc.
- Each invoice will include a dedicated "VAT agent" field in the header; we will mirror the agent name exactly as provided.
- Wire/ACH banking details and GL code mapping will be in the invoice footer.
- First withdrawal window: 7 days after invoice date; we will enforce a one-time auto-withdraw unless the customer confirms a hold.

Action items:
1) Samir — please share the VAT agent full legal name and the scanned authority letter (we can accept a signed PDF).
2) Kimberly — can you confirm if accounting needs any additional invoice fields (PO number placement / custom GL tag)?
3) Jordan — please approve the invoice numbering scheme and confirm we can emit M01..M06 for Oct–Mar.

Attachments: RBX_Invoice_Sample_Q4.pdf, RBX_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Best,
Priyom Das

Thanks — quick accounting notes from my side:
- We can add an explicit PO field at the top-right of the invoice (Brightbox PO will map to our "customer_reference" column when we export). Please have Samir include PO and remit id in the PO email.
- For EU VAT agent letters: we require either a signed PDF of the Letter of Authority or a notarized scan if the agent is outside the EU; otherwise a signed PDF is acceptable. We will store the file in our billing backlog and show the agent name on every invoice.
- GL mapping options: include GL:RB-INFER-001 in the invoice footer and also include an optional custom tag "client_gl" so you can ingest into your ledger.

Samir — if you send the agent PDF we will route to Legal to confirm storage and redaction rules.
